caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, symmetrical pattern composed mainly of floral and botanical motifs arranged in horizontal bands. The color palette consists of muted tones including beige, brown, pink, green, black, and hints of peach. In the upper section, an elongated oval shape takes center stage, bordered by concentric, organic forms and a prominent horizontal black band with white floral designs. Surrounding this oval are scroll-like, leafy patterns in pink and beige. The midsection features green leaves and stylized plant shapes interspersed with smaller black details resembling stems or vines. The central area is dominated by a large, stylized flower with radiating petals in brown, beige, and pink, with a textured black center. This is flanked on both sides by mirrored, black botanical designs. The background is a pale beige grid scattered with small red dots, adding texture and depth to the composition. The overall layout is rectangular with repeating patterns at the edges, contributing to a richly detailed, woven or printed textile appearance.
title: Hand Woven Ingrain Carpet
